description: Source code implementing conversions between UTF32, UTF-16, and UTF-8, including functions for encoding, decoding, and validation of UTF sequences.

methods.name: ConvertUTF32toUTF16
methods.description: Converts an array of UTF32 code points to UTF16 encoding, handling surrogate pairs and errors based on flags.

methods.name: ConvertUTF16toUTF32
methods.description: Converts UTF16 encoded data to UTF32 code points, handling surrogate pairs and errors.

methods.name: ConvertUTF16toUTF8
methods.description: Encodes UTF16 data into UTF8, handling surrogate pairs and buffer limits.

methods.name: ConvertUTF8toUTF16
methods.description: Decodes UTF8 data into UTF16, validating sequences and handling errors.

methods.name: ConvertUTF32toUTF8
methods.description: Encodes UTF32 data into UTF8, handling invalid code points and buffer limits.

methods.name: ConvertUTF8toUTF32
methods.description: Decodes UTF8 data into UTF32 code points, validating sequences and handling errors.

methods.name: isLegalUTF8
methods.description: Checks if a sequence of bytes is a valid UTF8 sequence of a given length.

methods.name: isLegalUTF8Sequence
methods.description: Checks if a UTF8 sequence starting at a given pointer is valid, considering sequence length.
